# Vendored dependencies

`agentation-3.0.2.tgz` was built from
[`thoriqakbar0/agentation`](https://github.com/thoriqakbar0/agentation) commit
`7aa6a867cfc6bccdc103c273d762527dd84a0cd5`.

The repository is a monorepo. Its installable `agentation` package is in `package/`, so the
repository root cannot replace the npm package directly.
